title: **Foreign Minister on the Quadrilateral Meeting of Defense and Security Officials of Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
text:
**Foreign Minister on the Quadrilateral Meeting of Defense and Security Officials of Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan"

"Tehran Meeting: Sustainable Security Hinges on Collective Responsibility"

"🔹 The recent Tehran meeting, attended by the Islamic Republic of Iran, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey, provided a valuable opportunity to advance dialogue on regional peace and security and joint countering of threats and challenges. Agreement to continue consultations is a significant step."

"🔹 Turning this opportunity into sustainable cooperation requires agreement on principles, confidence-building, mutual respect for the sovereignty of states and practical commitments."

"🔹 From the perspective of the Islamic Republic of Iran, sustainable security must be ensured through the participation of regional countries and without the military presence and intervention of extra-regional powers."

"🔹 This approach is based on the responsibility of regional countries to determine their own destiny."

"🔹 Countering the malign activities and aggression of the Israeli regime, within this same framework, is a fundamental necessity for defending the independence and sovereignty of states and preventing the expansion of war. Our neighbors, our priority."
